top_stories.title: Apple Sues OpenAI for Allegedly Stealing Hardware Secrets
top_stories.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that the company stole hardware trade secrets. The case centres on claims of intellectual property theft related to hardware, marking a significant legal clash between two major technology players.

top_stories.title: OpenAI's Head of Safety Is Leaving the Company
top_stories.summary: OpenAI's head of safety is departing the company, continuing a pattern of high-profile exits from the organisation's safety-focused roles. The departure raises fresh questions about the company's commitment to AI safety at a critical period of development.

top_stories.title: OpenAI's CEO of AGI Deployment, Fidji Simo, Is Stepping Down
top_stories.summary: Fidji Simo, who held the role of CEO of AGI Deployment at OpenAI, is stepping down from the position. The departure adds to a series of leadership changes at the company.

top_stories.title: The Download: Claude's Inner Workings and OpenAI's 'Super App' [Metered]
top_stories.summary: MIT Technology Review covers new research into Anthropic's Claude, examining what is happening inside the model's hidden computational space, alongside reporting on OpenAI's ambitions to build a 'super app'. The piece brings together two significant developments in frontier AI product and research.

top_stories.title: How Deutsche Telekom Is Rewiring Telecommunications with AI
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published a case study detailing how Deutsche Telekom is deploying AI across its telecommunications operations. The partnership illustrates the growing adoption of frontier AI tools in large enterprise and infrastructure contexts.

further_links.title: How the Terrorist Group Boko Haram Uses Frontier AI
further_links.summary: A report from CASP examines how the terrorist organisation Boko Haram is leveraging frontier AI tools, raising significant concerns about AI misuse for violent extremism.

further_links.title: Robot Dogs, Teslas, and Rescue Helicopters: The UN AI Summit Was a Lot [Metered]
further_links.summary: Wired reports on the UN AI Summit, describing a spectacle-heavy event featuring robot dogs and Teslas alongside substantive discussions about international AI governance.

further_links.title: Microsoft's Carbon Emissions Went Up 25 Percent Last Year
further_links.summary: Microsoft's 2026 sustainability report reveals its carbon emissions rose 25 percent year-on-year, a trend widely attributed to the surging energy demands of its AI infrastructure expansion.

further_links.title: Meta Turns Off the Instagram Feature That Let Users Make AI Deepfakes of Public Accounts
further_links.summary: Meta has disabled an Instagram feature that allowed users to generate AI deepfakes of public figures, citing concerns over misuse.

further_links.title: Would You Host Part of an AI Data Center in Your Home?
further_links.summary: The Verge reports on Sunrun's proposal to distribute AI data centre workloads across domestic solar and battery installations, presenting a novel model for decentralised AI compute.

further_links.title: Instagram's Adam Mosseri: If You Don't Like AI, 'Then You Shouldn't Have It in Your Feed'
further_links.summary: Instagram head Adam Mosseri has said users who dislike AI-generated content will be given controls to remove it from their feeds, framing AI integration as an opt-out rather than opt-in feature.

further_links.title: AI-Generated Videos to Maximally Drive a Target Brain Region
further_links.summary: Researchers at EPFL's NEVO project have developed a method using AI-generated videos specifically designed to maximally activate targeted brain regions, with implications for neuroscience research.

further_links.title: Building a Real-Time AI Tutor for 5-Year-Olds
further_links.summary: Ello's engineering blog details the technical challenges of building a real-time AI reading tutor responsive enough to work with young children, targeting a latency of under 1000 milliseconds.

further_links.title: A New Experiential Gallery Just Might Change Your Mind About AI Art [Metered]
further_links.summary: Wired profiles a new gallery experience designed to shift public perception of AI-generated art by immersing visitors in the creative process behind it.
